title: Morning sign desk: French interpretation
passage:
Welcome to the Hall A sign desk. The main talk runs on channel 2. Post an interpretation channel on the audience sign only while it is available for audience listening. The French interpreter is using channel 4 this morning. At 10:42 the French presenter had already finished and some listeners were returning their headsets, but the interpreter still had one slide to read on channel 4.

To remove a channel from the audience sign, use HIDE on the sign controls. It changes the display, not the audio signal. You can still listen on the rehearsal receiver with the channel hidden; muting the booth stops its feed and would stop even our rehearsal receiver from picking up its feed.
passageZh:
歡迎來到 A 廳告示臺。主講使用第 2 頻道。口譯頻道只在聽眾可以收聽時顯示於告示牌。今天上午的法語口譯員使用第 4 頻道。10:42，法語場主講人已講完，部分聽眾開始歸還耳機，但口譯員還要透過第 4 頻道讀完最後一張投影片。

如要從聽眾告示牌移除頻道，請在告示控制台按下 HIDE。它只改顯示，不切斷音訊。頻道隱藏後，仍可用彩排接收器收聽。將口譯室靜音會切斷傳送的訊號，連我們的彩排接收器也收不到。
